map.📋 吞咽功能(洼田饮水试验)分级器: 📌 Swallowing Function (Kubota Water Drinking Test) Grader
map.洼田饮水试验(Kubota Water Drinking Test)，让患者饮3: The Kubota Water Drinking Test lets the patient drink 30 mL of warm water and grades swallowing function by time and performance
map.洼田饮水试验让患者饮 30 mL 温水并观察：1 级为 5 秒内一次饮完且无呛咳: In the Kubota water drinking test the patient drinks 30 mL of warm water while being observed: grade 1 means finished in one go within 5 seconds with no choking (normal); grade 2 means finished in 2 or more goes with no choking (questionable); grade 3 means finished in one go with choking (abnormal); grade 4 means finished in 2 or more goes with choking (abnormal); grade 5 means repeated choking with difficulty swallowing it all (abnormal). Grade 1 is normal, grade 2 is questionable and needs re-evaluation, and grades 3 to 5 indicate dysphagia, so aspiration risk should be assessed and the feeding method and food texture adjusted.
map.本试验有呛咳误吸风险，需在专业人员监督下进行。如患者已明确有严重吞咽障碍，不建议: This test carries a risk of choking and aspiration and must be performed under professional supervision. If the patient is known to have severe dysphagia, this test is not recommended.
map.一次饮完，无呛咳: Finished in one go, no choking
map.两次饮完，无呛咳: Finished in two goes, no choking
map.一次饮完，有呛咳: Finished in one go, with choking
map.两次饮完，有呛咳: Finished in two goes, with choking
map.频繁呛咳，难以全部咽下: Frequent choking, difficulty swallowing it all
map.📊 洼田饮水试验分级标准: 📌A Kubota water drinking test grading standard
map.一次饮完，无呛咳（≤5秒）: Finished in one go, no choking (within 5 s)
map.一次饮完，无呛咳（>5秒）: Finished in one go, no choking (over 5 s)
map.需改变饮食形态，专业吞咽治疗: The diet form must change, professional swallowing therapy needed
map.需管饲营养，系统吞咽康复: Tube feeding nutrition and systematic swallowing rehabilitation needed
map.可进食普通饮食，注意细嚼慢咽。Ⅱ级患者建议避免过干过硬食物，进食时保持坐位。: A normal diet can be taken with careful chewing and slow eating. Grade II patients should avoid very dry or hard foods and stay upright while eating.
map.建议进食软食或半流质，避免干硬、多渣食物。每口量适中（约15-20ml），进食时: Soft or semi-liquid food is recommended, avoiding dry, hard and fibrous foods. Keep the bite size moderate (about 15-20 mL), allow plenty of mealtime and maintain the correct posture.
map.建议进食糊状食物或增稠液体，避免稀液体和混合质地食物。需专业吞咽治疗师指导，进行: Puréed food or thickened liquids are recommended, avoiding thin liquids and mixed-texture foods. A professional swallowing therapist should guide direct swallowing training.
map.需鼻胃管或PEG管饲营养支持。在专业评估指导下尝试间接吞咽训练，待功能改善后逐步: Nasogastric or PEG tube feeding support is needed. Try indirect swallowing training under professional assessment guidance and gradually transition to oral intake once function improves.
map.📚 深度解析：吞咽功能（洼田饮水试验）分级: 📝A In-depth analysis: swallowing function (Kubota water drinking test) grading
map.5s 内一次饮完 30mL 无呛咳为 1 级，可经口进食；>5s 或分 2 次为: Finishing 30 mL in one go within 5 s with no choking is grade 1 and oral intake is fine; over 5 s or finishing in 2 goes is grade 2 and needs observation.
map.2 次以上饮完或伴呛咳为 3 级，有误吸风险，改糊状食物+吞咽训练，必要时鼻饲。: Finishing in 2 or more goes or with choking is grade 3, with aspiration risk; switch to puréed food plus swallowing training and use nasogastric feeding if necessary.
map.1 正常、2 可疑、3 经 2 次以上/呛、4 全程呛、5 不能咽；≥3 级建议: 1 normal, 2 questionable, 3 over 2 goes or choking, 4 choking throughout, 5 cannot swallow; grade 3 or above calls for instrumental swallowing assessment.
map.阴性就能正常吃饭吗？: Does a normal result mean the patient can eat normally?
map.不能据此放行。洼田试验主要筛查显性误吸：喝 30 mL 温水顺利一次咽下为 1: Not on its own. The Kubota test mainly screens for overt aspiration: drinking 30 mL of warm water smoothly in one go is grade 1. But some patients have silent aspiration (food enters the airway without choking), which the Kubota test cannot detect. So a grade 1 patient who still has recurrent fever, increased sputum or weight loss needs further FEES (fiberoptic endoscopic evaluation of swallowing) or VFSS (videofluoroscopic swallowing study). Also note that water temperature and thickness affect the result, so testing should consistently use room-temperature water.
